integrity.claim_scope: A constructive existence theorem valid for every integer k>=2, with exact finite calculations as corroboration only.
integrity.prior_work_credit: Basic topological extinction rules, marginal probability calculations, and ecological robustness models are credited to published literature.

limitations: One-step topological coextinction under independent uniform primary losses; exponentially separated consumer degrees, very large networks, and late peaks close to complete primary extinction. Neither empirical prevalence nor exactly k extrema is asserted.
title: Arbitrarily many coextinction-variance peaks in connected ecological networks
